theorem: Reducing the 240-coordinate edge-phase vectors modulo two collapses the 720 signatures to 72 patterns. The 27 weight-160 patterns carry SRG(27,10,1,5); the 45 weight-64 patterns are exactly its 45 triangles, with incidence degrees 3 and 5. This is the abstract Schlaefli 27-line/45-tritangent incidence structure.
